content.raw:
Move your WordPress site to Mishka CMS

Every part of this page was laid out with Elementor. Read about the team, or start with the welcome post.

A second paragraph, with bold and italic words.

Contact us

What comes across

  • Pages and their layout
  • Posts, categories and tags
  • Read the documentation
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw

Before

A WordPress site with Elementor pages. Two paragraphs written the classic way.

After

The same page in Mishka CMS, open in its page builder.
